light_description: Portuguese amp-in-a-box overdrive with multiple clipping options and Dumble-influenced voicing.
Portuguese JRC4558-based distortion documented in 2026 dealer coverage, occupying Rat-adjacent gain territory.
Portuguese harmonic overdrive with Sweet/Salty voicing and compression options.
Portuguese modern fuzz based on a 1960s smiling-fuzz concept, with Grain and Coarse controls for texture and low-frequency response.
Portuguese always-on tone-shaping preamp/overdrive with five controls and buffered bypass.
